CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_common_allowance_private.session_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare claims jsonb:=auth.jwt();sid text:=claims->>'session_id';
begin
 if auth.uid() is null or private.account_access_allowed() is not true
 or claims->>'role' is distinct from 'authenticated' or claims->>'is_anonymous'='true'
 or sid is null or sid !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
 or not exists(select 1 from auth.sessions where id=sid::uuid and user_id=auth.uid() and (not_after is null or not_after>clock_timestamp())) then
  raise exception 'company common allowance session unavailable' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return sid::uuid;
end $function$
